start: Workout plans page, gym online, gym has members

steps.action: Open Workout plans
user_sees: Title 'Workout plans', 'Send members their routines', button '+ New plan', the line 'Members see it in the MettleUp app after one check-in at the gym.', the workout of the day card, section 'Plans' (or 'No workout plans yet' with 'Make a plan once (for example “Beginner 3 days”) and send it to members or to everyone on a membership plan.')

steps.action: Tap '+ New plan', then 'Start empty' ('Pick every exercise yourself')

steps.action: Name it, add two exercises from the search, set 'Sets', 'Reps from', 'Reps to', 'Start kg (optional)', 'Rest (seconds)'
user_sees: Each exercise with its muscles or 'Your own exercise'; hints 'Empty: they choose' / 'Until they log their own' / 'Empty: their own timer'
must_not: Reps from above reps to accepted
A start weight forced on the member after they log their own

steps.action: Under 'Send to' search a member and pick a membership plan, save
user_sees: The pill 'Sending' on what is picked; the sheet closes; the plan is in 'Plans' with who it goes to; the maker's name is kept on a new plan
must_not: The plan sent to members not picked
The plan sent to a member of another branch
The save shown as done while it failed ('Could not save this plan.')
